build_command: npx pnpm install && npx pnpm build
lint_command: node scripts/run-oxlint-shards.mjs --threads=8 && node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json && npx pnpm check:docs
test_command: node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents-embedded-agent.config.ts --reporter=verbose && node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.unit-fast-fake-timers.config.ts --reporter=verbose
